title: Liquidity Watch: Loan Demand Outpacing Deposit Growth
description: Loan-to-share is near 89% and rising as loan growth outpaces share growth. Projected to approach the internal policy ceiling by Q1 on the current trend. (Illustrative projection on a real ratio.)
data_note: Real ratio from the NCUA call report (Dec 2025); the projection and the policy ceiling are illustrative.

confidence.rationale: Loan balances from the core snapshot, share balances from the finance and ALM workbook, and origination volume from the lending system reconcile to a single governed loan-to-share ratio, validated overnight. Confidence is held below 100 because the Howard University division has not folded into the consolidated view.

action: Launch a targeted education-community deposit campaign and arrange a standby funding line before the gap widens.
source_text: Core banking snapshot + lending system + finance and ALM workbook.

title: Post-Merger Reconciliation Gap: Howard University Division
description: Howard University division balances have not fully reconciled into the enterprise deposit and membership totals. Share balances and member counts differ between the merged ledger and the enterprise data warehouse. Reconcile before citing consolidated numbers. (Illustrative.)
data_note: The merger is real (effective Nov 30, 2024). The reconciliation state and the delta are illustrative — merger balances were never publicly disclosed.

confidence.rationale: The enterprise figure reconciles cleanly across core and finance and traces to source. The consolidated figure does not: the division mapping is incomplete, so the delta is identified and attributable but not yet closed.

action: Reconcile the division balances and confirm the consolidated deposit figure before it goes to the board.
source_text: Howard University division ledger vs enterprise data warehouse.

title: Deposit Seasonality Window Approaching
description: The education field of membership drives a predictable summer deposit drawdown and payroll-cycle inflows tied to the academic calendar. The next favorable inflow window is approaching. (Illustrative pattern on a real membership base.)
data_note: Illustrative pattern on a real education-sector membership base.

confidence.rationale: Seasonal shape is drawn from historical deposit patterns by member segment across prior academic years; the amplitude varies year to year, which is why the forecast carries a band rather than a line.

action: Time the deposit campaign to the calendar so it lands ahead of the inflow window, not after the summer draw.
source_text: Historical deposit patterns by member segment.

title: Membership Growth and Howard University Conversion

data_note: Membership base is real (NCUA, Dec 2025). Conversion figures are illustrative.

confidence.rationale: Member counts reconcile between the membership system and the enterprise warehouse for the legacy base; the division count carries the same pending flag as the deposit reconciliation.

action: Convert new Howard University members into primary depositors to strengthen the funding base.
